org.guita.YapYap.appstream-external-screenshot-url: Flathub's own build mirrors the screenshots to dl.flathub.org when it publishes YapYap; a CI build cannot (#119).
org.guita.YapYap.appstream-failed-validation: The only failure is releases-info-missing: pull request builds are not releases, and release builds stamp the release into the metainfo first.
org.guita.YapYap.appstream-screenshots-not-mirrored-in-os: Follows from the same: Flathub's build commits the mirrored screenshots (#119).
